1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Nf3 Nbd7 5.c.strategy: Develops with pressure on the f6 knight, which cannot leave without exposing the queen, so Black's active ...Ne4 idea is hard to carry out. White keeps the choice between a minority attack and a central advance.
Develops the bishop on the other diagonal, so it cannot be hit by ...h6 and keeps a grip on e5. White gives up the pin on f6 and keeps the choice between a minority attack and a central advance.

1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Nf3 Nbd7 5.c.strategy: Supports the d5 pawn and opens the a5-d8 diagonal for the queen. The knight on d7 already guards f6, so the pin is harmless. Black builds a solid centre and prepares a patient game.
